operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero
pool: the capital-eligible donors from distortion_tool.html, as used by the vignettes and vignette_uncertainty.py
evaluated_at: posterior-mean operator parameters and posterior-mean syndicate intercepts; parameter uncertainty is NOT propagated here, so these are point sensitivities

clean_donor_location_is_transferred_and_.note: adding a to a clean donor moves the transferred value by (sigma_q/sigma_i)*a; the operator does not remove location

ritc_location_is_not_separable.note: adding a to an RITC donor does NOT move the transferred value by (sigma_q/sigma_i)*a; the rank map is nonlinear

demeaning_removes_the_level.note: subtracting alpha_i before standardising removes lambda*alpha_i

transferred_library_centre.estimator: identified per row; the operator as implemented does no de-meaning

tail_sensitivity_to_donor_location.note: what the operator's stresses become if donor location is removed before standardising; the operator itself is unchanged

overlay_sensitivity.operator_construction: concentration overlay: the gamma-free fit, its fitted concentration exponent gamma (each posterior draw, or the posterior mean) and its own k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div and nu; a labelled sensitivity, not the headline
overlay_sensitivity.pool: the capital-eligible donors from distortion_tool.html, as used by the vignettes and vignette_uncertainty.py
overlay_sensitivity.evaluated_at: posterior-mean operator parameters and posterior-mean syndicate intercepts; parameter uncertainty is NOT propagated here, so these are point sensitivities
